changelog.summary: Adds an exact-invoice recovery review, approved contact evidence and provider-backed collection and deposit states for subscription receivables.

title: Subscription Receivable to Verified Outcome
description: Investigate one overdue or failed-payment subscription invoice, prepare policy-safe follow-up, and verify collection without confusing a payment with a bank deposit.
setup_prompt: Use Subscription Receivable to Verified Outcome as a proposal. Inspect my existing Billing Operations and Finance Analyst Crews and their Invoice Chasing or Failed Payment Recovery packs. Bind one exact invoice, current provider account and mode, retry and contact policy, and finance sources. Propose a reviewed case-to-outcome route with blocking validators and a manual first run. Show the concrete plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not retry a charge, send a reminder, write off an invoice, post a ledger entry, or start recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Exact subscription invoice, customer and provider account or export
Entity, live/test mode, currency, cutoff and invoice due date
Retry, customer contact, suppression and approval policies
Authorized payment, payout and ledger or bank source
Billing case owner, finance reviewer and contact authority
Manual-only or reviewed event and recurrence policy

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing specialists using stable idempotency keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass only the validated invoice review to the finance Crew

recommended_tools.name: Stripe or another billing provider, or authorized export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact invoice, payment attempts, retry plan, contact and collection status

recommended_tools.name: Accounting, payout and bank connection or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify deposited and reconciled state separately from provider collection

recommended_tools.name: Authorized email or billing notification provider
recommended_tools.purpose: Provide a receipt for a separately approved customer reminder

pulse_focus.label: Subscription receivable recovery
focus_areas: Open balance and retry or contact state for the exact invoice
Collected amount versus deposited and reconciled amount
review_when: An attempt fails, a due date passes, a payment is observed, or a payout settles

outputs: Validated finance outcome with collection and settlement limits
Manual case run and owner decision
